Title: VEN-020 — venue_bookings schema + RLS: booking lifecycle + idempotency + audit
Description:
## Summary

Create the `venue_bookings` table with full lifecycle states, RLS policies for host/owner access, idempotency key, and integration with `audit_logs`. Unblocks `requestVenueBooking` tool and `check_availability` read queries.

## Done when

- [ ] Migration at `supabase/migrations/YYYYMMDD_venue_bookings.sql` with:
  - `venue_bookings(id uuid PK, venue_id uuid FK venues, host_id uuid FK auth.users, date date, time_start time, time_end time, guests int, status text, cost_estimate numeric, deposit_amount numeric, idempotency_key text UNIQUE, notes text, created_at timestamptz)`
  - Status enum: `pending | approved | rejected | cancelled | completed`
  - Constraint: `idempotency_key = sha256(venue_id || host_id || date || time_start)`
- [ ] RLS enabled; policies:
  - `host_owns_bookings`: host can INSERT own bookings; SELECT/UPDATE own rows
  - `owner_sees_venue_bookings`: venue owner can SELECT + UPDATE bookings for their venues
  - `admin_all_bookings`: admin role sees all
- [ ] `supabase db push` applied to project `zkwcbyxiwklihegjhuql`
- [ ] Vitest: host cannot read another host's bookings; owner can read own venue's bookings

## Implementation notes

* Idempotency key prevents double-booking on network retry: `sha256(venue_id || host_id || date || time_start)` — insert with `ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING`
* Lifecycle state machine: `pending` → `approved` (owner action) → `completed` (post-event); OR `pending` → `rejected`/`cancelled` (either party)
* `audit_logs` integration: trigger or application-level write on every status change — `action: "venue_booking_status_changed"`, `payload: { from_status, to_status }`
* `cost_estimate` and `deposit_amount` stored at booking time — not recomputed on read (price may change)

## Critical rules

* RLS is mandatory — owner must NOT see bookings from other venues; host must NOT see another host's bookings
* `idempotency_key` UNIQUE constraint prevents race conditions from double-submit
* `deposit_amount` is informational at booking time — actual charge happens in Stripe after owner approval

## References

* Skill: `.claude/skills/mde-supabase`

* Blocks: VEN-015 requestVenueBooking tool, VEN-010 check_availability
* Related: DATA-001 audit_logs (SAN-756), WF-004 venueShortlistWorkflow (SAN-747)

Title: VEN-015 — requestVenueBooking HITL: Mastra tool + CopilotKit generative booking card
Description:
## Summary

Implement the `requestVenueBooking` HITL Mastra tool and its matching CopilotKit generative card. When Roberto (or any event host) confirms a venue shortlist, the agent surfaces a booking confirmation card — no auto-submission until the host clicks "Send Request".

## Done when

- [ ] `requestVenueBooking(venue_id, date, time_start, time_end, guests, notes)` tool uses `renderAndWaitForResponse` — suspends until host confirms
- [ ] HITL card shows: venue name, date, time range, guest count, estimated cost (`hours × price_per_hour`), 30% deposit amount, "This sends a request to \[owner_name\]" note
- [ ] On `respond({ confirmed: true })`: writes row to `venue_bookings` with `status: 'pending'`; owner notified (Supabase realtime or edge function)
- [ ] On `respond({ confirmed: false })`: tool returns cancelled state; no write
- [ ] `useCopilotAction({ name: "requestVenueBooking", available: "disabled", render: BookingHITLCard })` mirrors the HITL in chat
- [ ] `BookingHITLCard` renders: venue photo, all booking details, \[✅ Send Request\] and \[✕ Cancel\] buttons
- [ ] Audit log: every `respond({ confirmed: true })` writes to `audit_logs(action: "venue_booking_requested", user_id, entity_id: venue_id, payload: { date, guests, cost_estimate })`
- [ ] Vitest: `requestVenueBooking` suspends until `respond()` called; `venue_bookings` row exists after confirm; no row after cancel

## Implementation notes

* Pre-fill from working memory: if `MdeState.eventDraft` has `date` and `expected_capacity`, pass them as defaults to the HITL card
* Cost estimate: `Math.ceil((time_end - time_start) / 3600) * venue.price_per_hour`; deposit = `cost_estimate * 0.30`
* Idempotency: check for existing `venue_bookings` row before writing (same venue_id + date + host_id) to prevent double-submit on retry
* Owner notification: POST to `/api/notifications/venue-booking-request` — does NOT charge deposit at this step (approval flow)

## Critical rules

* `requestVenueBooking` MUST use `renderAndWaitForResponse` — never auto-submit booking without explicit host confirmation
* Deposit is NOT charged at booking request time — only after owner approves (charged via Stripe in a follow-up step)
* Audit log write is mandatory — no silent booking mutations
* Every `<AdvancedMarker>` on the venue detail page must use `getMapId()` (SAN-788)

* Skill: `.claude/skills/mastra`, `.claude/skills/copilotkitV1`

Implement the three core Mastra tools for `venueAgent` (already registered at SAN-740): `search_venues`, `get_venue_details`, and `check_availability`. These power the venue shortlist flow on `/venues` — Roberto describes his event, agent returns ranked venue cards with AI pick reasons.

- [ ] `search_venues(query, capacity, type, amenities[])` tool queries Supabase `venues` table + optional Places API enrichment; returns `VenueResult[]` with `ai_pick_reason` (e.g. "Best catering match for 250 guests")
- [ ] Results update `MdeState.mapPins[]` with `entity_type: "venue"`, gray pin color
- [ ] `get_venue_details(venue_id)` returns full venue record: amenities, pricing tiers (Mon–Thu/Fri–Sun), capacity range, owner profile
- [ ] `check_availability(venue_id, date, duration_hours)` queries `venue_bookings` table for conflicts; returns `{ available: boolean, next_available: string | null }`

Title: DATA-VEN-001 — Venue + restaurant + nightlife data seed: Places API backfill cron
Description:
## Summary

Seed the `venues`, `restaurants`, and `nightlife` tables with real Medellín inventory by running a Places API backfill — fetching top venues by category from El Poblado, Laureles, and El Centro neighborhoods. Without this data, venueAgent returns empty results.

## Done when

- [ ] `scripts/seed-venues.ts` fetches from Places API New `searchNearby` for each combination of `(neighborhood, type)`:
  - `type: "event_venue"` → `venues` table
  - `type: "restaurant"` → `restaurants` table
  - `type: "night_club" | "bar"` → `nightlife` table
- [ ] `X-Goog-FieldMask: places.id,places.displayName,places.formattedAddress,places.location,places.rating,places.priceLevel,places.regularOpeningHours` on every fetch
- [ ] Upsert on `external_id = places.id` — idempotent, safe to re-run
- [ ] Minimum seeded: 10 venues, 20 restaurants, 10 nightlife in El Poblado + Laureles
- [ ] `supabase/seeds/venues.sql` generated from script output for deterministic test fixtures
- [ ] Supabase scheduled cron (`pg_cron` or Vercel cron) refreshes stale records weekly
- [ ] RLS: anon can SELECT `status = 'active'` rows; only service-role INSERT/UPDATE
- [ ] Vitest: `venues` table has ≥1 row with `neighborhood = 'El Poblado'` after seed

## Implementation notes

* Neighborhoods to seed: El Poblado, Laureles, El Centro (the 3 most tourist-dense)
* Rate limit: 10 req/s on Places API New — batch with 100ms delay between calls
* `priceLevel` mapping: Places `PRICE_LEVEL_INEXPENSIVE` → `$`, `MODERATE` → `$$`, `EXPENSIVE` → `$$$`
* Store `places_id` (Google's ID) as `external_id` for future re-enrichment without re-search
* The cron refresh should only update `rating`, `regularOpeningHours.openNow` — not change `name` or `address` (to preserve manual edits)

## Critical rules

* `X-Goog-FieldMask` required — do not request `photos`, `reviews`, or `websiteUri` unless a UI component displays them (those SKUs are billed separately)
* Backfill script runs with service-role key — must be in `scripts/`, never `src/`
* Seed data is test infrastructure — do NOT commit real `places_id` values to version control (they could change)

## References

* Skill: `.claude/skills/mde-maps`, `.claude/skills/mde-supabase`
* Related: venueAgent tools VEN-010, SEARCH-001 (SAN-790), MAP-005 FieldMask audit (SAN-776)
* Wireframe: `docs/wireframes/venues/001-venue-search.md`
